openfx.plugin.label: Keymaster
openfx.plugin.description: AI green-screen keyer powered by CorridorKey 2.0. Press Key clip to analyze the whole clip, then choose an output.
openfx.param.key.label: Key clip
openfx.param.key.hint: Analyzes every frame of the source clip with the AI keyer. This can take several minutes; you can cancel it from the progress window.
openfx.param.output.label: Output
openfx.param.output.hint: What the effect shows once the clip is keyed.
openfx.param.hint_quality.label: Hint quality
openfx.param.hint_quality.hint: How hard the keyer works on the rough matte it starts from. Higher is cleaner and slower. Press Key clip again after changing it.
openfx.param.despill.label: Despill
openfx.param.despill.hint: How much green spill to remove from the foreground. Press Key clip again after changing it.
openfx.param.encoding.label: Clip encoding
openfx.param.encoding.hint: How the pixel values reaching this effect are encoded. Use Gamma-encoded for DaVinci Resolve timelines and Scene linear for Nuke.
openfx.param.clear.label: Clear key
openfx.param.clear.hint: Deletes the cached key for this clip and goes back to showing the source.
openfx.param.cache_dir.label: Cache folder
openfx.param.key_token.label: Key ID
openfx.status.not_keyed: Not keyed yet. Press Key clip to analyze the whole clip; until then the source passes through.
openfx.status.missing: The cached key for this clip is missing. Press Key clip again; until then the source passes through.
openfx.status.stale: The source clip or the key settings changed since this clip was keyed. Press Key clip again; until then the source passes through.
openfx.error.no_core: Keymaster's core is not installed. Install keymaster-core, or set KEYMASTER_PYTHON and KEYMASTER_CORE.
openfx.error.no_python: The Python interpreter for Keymaster was not found: {path}
openfx.error.core_missing: The Keymaster core folder was not found: {path}
openfx.error.no_source: Connect a clip to the Source input before keying.
openfx.error.fetch_failed: Could not read frame {frame} of the source clip from the host.
openfx.error.write_failed: Could not write to the Keymaster cache: {detail}
openfx.error.start_failed: Could not start the Keymaster core: {detail}
openfx.error.no_outputs: The Keymaster core finished without producing any images.
